description: This header file defines a utility class 'DateUtils' within the 'DateCalculationUnitTests' namespace. The class provides static methods for converting between SYSTEMTIME and Windows::Foundation::DateTime, as well as formatting a SYSTEMTIME into a long date string using Windows.Globalization APIs.

classes.name: DateUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date and time conversions and formatting within Windows Runtime applications.

methods.name: SystemTimeToDateTime
methods.description: Converts a SYSTEMTIME structure to a Windows::Foundation::DateTime object.

methods.name: DateTimeToSystemTime
methods.description: Converts a Windows::Foundation::DateTime object to a SYSTEMTIME structure.

methods.name: GetLongDate
methods.description: Returns a long date string representation of a SYSTEMTIME using Windows.Globalization formatting.
